stories.headline: Pop Mart Quarterly Sales Plunge 50% Amid Sharp Drop in Americas Demand
stories.summary: Pop Mart reported steep quarterly revenue declines, including a 25% to 30% drop in China and a 70% to 75% plunge in sales across the Americas.
stories.why: Pop Mart is a leading designer toy and pop culture merchandise retailer headquartered in China, relying on global consumer demand for novelty collectibles.

impacts.name: Pop Mart International Group
impacts.why: Sharp revenue drops in primary markets undermine investor revenue growth expectations.

stories.why_moved: A severe decline in Americas sales signals weakening consumer demand for the company's flagship merchandise.

stories.headline: Singapore Exchange Proposes Five-Directorship Limit to Enhance Corporate Governance
stories.summary: The Singapore Exchange and corporate governance regulators proposed capping listed board directorships at five to strengthen director oversight and independence.

stories.headline: Bank of Japan Releases Core CPI Underlying Inflation Measures
stories.summary: The Bank of Japan published updated economic metrics detailing underlying trends in core consumer price inflation.

stories.headline: Bank of Korea Warns Chip Exports Could Drop by $100 Billion if AI Spending Slows
stories.summary: The Bank of Korea modelled a pessimistic scenario warning that South Korea's semiconductor exports could fall by up to US$100 billion if artificial intelligence spending slows down.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy

impacts.name: Clean Technology
impacts.why: Heavy reliance on concentrated foreign supply chains creates trade and operational risks.

stories.summary: Asian currencies traded mixed while the US dollar held firm and the Japanese yen retreated ahead of the upcoming Federal Reserve policy decision.

stories.summary: Former Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda expressed support for further interest rate hikes, while his former deputy urged caution on monetary tightening.
